title: EYE Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for EYE AI Forensic Assistant configuration file

model_name.description: Name of the model to use (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'llama2', 'claude-3')

executable_path.description: Path to executable for CLI agents (required for local_cli integration_type)

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint URL for local API servers (required for local_api integration_type)

last_validated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful connectivity validation

context_window.description: Context window and token budget configuration. All fields are optional; the Eye supplies defaults for any that are absent.

max_total_tokens.description: Fallback context window size (tokens) for models whose real window is unknown. For known cloud models the real window is auto-resolved and this is ignored unless lock_max_total_tokens is true; local servers are sized by their runtime n_ctx probe.

lock_max_total_tokens.description: Pin max_total_tokens to the configured value and disable automatic resolution to the backend model's real context window.

max_tool_output_chars.description: Maximum characters allowed for tool output before memory truncation

store_full_payload.description: Persist the full payload sent to the model per evidence seal so the Compliance log can reproduce (not just verify) each turn.

sealed_payload_recent_uncompressed.description: Keep this many recent sealed payloads uncompressed; older ones are compressed (zstd, gzip fallback).

token_budget.description: Optional per-component token allocation. When absent it is auto-scaled to the resolved context window; an explicit value pins it.

sliding_window_size.description: Number of recent messages to preserve

preserve_first_message.description: Whether to always preserve the first message

preserve_tool_messages.description: Whether to preserve messages containing tool calls

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0.0-1.0) to preserve evidence
